entries.title: Quantum sensor loop design could improve magnetic measurements for medicine and communications
entries.summary: Adelaide University quantum engineers have found a new way to improve some of the world's most sensitive sensors of electromagnetic fields, a breakthrough that could help advance brain imaging, medical diagnostics, communications technology and next-generation quantum devices.
